This all lines up with what we agreed. Going down your list, I can see each thing I care about has a home: the automatic details when saving, the read-later list, search with filters and sorting, editing with the tag suggestions, archive and restore, and bringing bookmarks in and out with a full backup. Nothing I asked for seems to have fallen off.

I don't have opinions about how you slice up the work or what runs in parallel — that's your craft. Starting with the paste-a-link-and-save flow as the first usable piece makes sense to me as a natural first milestone.

Please go ahead and start building.
